destariamasteries:alchemy-mastery-desc: Turn nature's ingredients into deadly weapons and potent buffs. The Alchemy mastery unlocks the ability to brew powerful potions, coat weapons in lingering toxins, and unleash devastating explosive and chemical attacks.
destariamasteries:alchemy-basicconcoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft minor potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalnourishm: Consuming mushrooms provides {0} additional saturation and increases your healing effectiveness by {1}%% for 10 seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxictransmuta: Reduces the harmful effects of consuming mushrooms by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-fungalfingers-: Unlocks the ability to craft mushroom substrate.
destariamasteries:alchemy-virulentreacti: Increases the damage potency of your poisons by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-potentdecoctio: Unlocks the ability to craft highly potent potions and poisons.
destariamasteries:alchemy-dazzleblast-de: Blinds a targeted enemy for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-poisoncloud-de:
Creates a lingering cloud of poison for {0} seconds.
Requires a mushroom. The cloud's poison damage is dependent on the type of mushroom used.
destariamasteries:alchemy-concussiveblas: (Modifies Dazzle Blast) The targeted enemy will be deafened for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-primedtoxin-de: Coats your equipped blade in poison, causing your attacks to poison targets for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-granddetonatio: Unlocks the ability to craft powerful explosives.
destariamasteries:alchemy-toxicreserves-: While poisoned, your movement speed is increased by {0}%% and hunger depletion is reduced by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:alchemy-costlymistake-: Inflicts poison upon yourself for {0} seconds.
destariamasteries:alchemy-catalyticsurge: Purges all poison effects from yourself, healing you for {0}%% of the damage the poison would have dealt.
destariamasteries:mechanist-mastery-desc: Unlocks the mastery of clockwork and engineering, transforming raw metal and ingenuity into survival. Whether automating industry or deploying precision weaponry, you bend machines to your absolute will.
destariamasteries:mechanist-combatengine: Unlocks the ability to craft Simple Crossbows and increases crossbow damage by {0}%%.
Unlocks the ability to craft Simple Crossbows and Repeating Crossbows, and increases crossbow damage by {0}%%.
Unlocks the ability to craft Simple Crossbows, Repeating Crossbows, and Latch Crossbows, and increases crossbow damage by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-tinkering-de:
Gain the ability to craft chutes, hoppers, axles, and angled gears.
Also increases damage against mechanical creatures by {0}%%.

Gain the ability to craft chutes, hoppers, axles, angled gears, helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, and their remaining associated parts.
Also increases damage against mechanical creatures by {0}%%.

Gain the ability to craft chutes, hoppers, axles, angled gears, helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, reinforced rotors, and their remaining associated parts.
Also increases damage against mechanical creatures by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-delicatetouc: Accustomed to handling small, fragile components, your touch is precise and practiced. Chisels, hammers, shears, saws, and knives have a {0}%% chance to not lose durability when used.
destariamasteries:mechanist-tuning-desc: Unlocks the ability to craft and use the Tuning Spear.
destariamasteries:mechanist-mechanicalta:
Decreases the damage dealt by your Tuning Spear to mechanical creatures by {0}%%.
This skill is mutually exclusive with Mechanical Slayer.

Decreases the damage dealt by your Tuning Spear to mechanical creatures by {0}%%.
Allows the hacking of sawblade locusts.
destariamasteries:mechanist-mechanicalsl:
Increases the damage dealt by your Tuning Spear to mechanical creatures by {0}%%.
This skill is mutually exclusive with Mechanical Tamer.
destariamasteries:mechanist-efficientcon: Yields one extra item when crafting chutes, hoppers, axles, and angled gears.
Yields one extra item when crafting chutes, hoppers, axles, angled gears, helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, and their remaining associated parts.

Yields two extra items when crafting chutes, hoppers, axles, and angled gears.
Yields one extra item when crafting helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, reinforced rotors, and their remaining associated parts.
Yields two extra items when crafting chutes, hoppers, axles, angled gears, helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, and their remaining associated parts.

Yields two extra items when crafting chutes, hoppers, axles, angled gears, helve hammers, pounders, basic windmills, and their remaining associated parts. Crafting reinforced rotors yields one extra item.
destariamasteries:mechanist-eyeforcrafts: While wearing glasses, you gain {0}%% more loot from mechanical creatures.
destariamasteries:mechanist-scrapmechani: Convert {0} metal scraps into {1} rusty gear(s).
destariamasteries:mechanist-antiarmor-de: Unlocks the ability to craft the Goat Foot Crossbow.
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporaladju: Once every 24 hours, imbue a rusty gear with your life energy to transform it into a temporal gear. This inflicts 7.5 unmodifiable damage.
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporalinur: Reduces the rate at which you lose temporal stability by {0}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-antianything: Unlocks the ability to craft the Windless Crossbow.
destariamasteries:mechanist-producttesti: Reduces crossbow dispersion by {0}%% and increases crossbow damage by {1}%%.
destariamasteries:mechanist-refineddevel: Craft chutes with cupronickel for double the output.
Craft chutes with cupronickel for double the output. Wooden mechanical parts, such as axles, gears, and clutches, no longer require tools to craft.

Craft chutes with cupronickel for double the output. Wooden mechanical parts, such as axles, gears, and clutches, no longer require tools to craft. Unlocks the Jonas Screw, which uses a temporal gear to provide a slow, continuous source of mechanical power.
destariamasteries:mechanist-wardagainstm: Understanding the mechanisms behind mechanical creatures improves your defensive instincts. You take {0}%% less damage from mechanical creatures and {1}%% less damage from other monsters.
destariamasteries:mechanist-turnbackthec: Once per day (resetting at 0:00 UTC), when dealt a fatal blow, time fractures to save you. Your body is thrown backward through time, rewinding you to your spawn point with {0}%% health.
destariamasteries:mechanist-stormchaser-: Your time spent around temporal machinery grants you insight into their power sources, giving you a sixth sense for their ebb and flow. You know precisely when the next temporal storm will arrive.
destariamasteries:mechanist-temporaldeva: Once every 30 minutes, violently shatter a temporal gear to rip apart the fabric of time. All monsters within 12 blocks take {0} damage, leaving their remains utterly mangled. The chronal backwash causes all players in the area to lose {1}%% temporal stability within one second and slows them by {1}%% for 2 seconds.
destariamasteries:homesteader-mastery-de: Unlocks the art of sustainable living and agriculture, turning the untamed wilderness into a flourishing estate. Whether cultivating resilient crops, tending orchards, or managing livestock, you master the rhythms of the land to thrive off the grid.
destariamasteries:homesteader-subsistenc: Gain the ability to turn harvested crops into seeds, and harvest {0}%% more crops, berries, and fruits from fruit trees. Gain {1}%% more meat from animals and fish.
destariamasteries:homesteader-ambercombs: When harvesting skeps, they no longer break down into their components. You also yield 50%% more honeycombs.
destariamasteries:homesteader-emeraldbou: When taking cuttings from bushes and fruit trees, you gain twice as many. You also receive twice as many tree seeds and are guaranteed to get at least one sapling when cutting down a tree.
destariamasteries:homesteader-goldenfiel: You gain {0}%% more yield when harvesting crops. Crops you plant have a ±5°C greater temperature tolerance.
destariamasteries:homesteader-deepblue-d: You receive {0}%% more meat when cleaning fish. You can also craft fishing bait from fruits, grains, and vegetables.
destariamasteries:homesteader-whispersin: You gain {0}%% more yield from animals.
destariamasteries:homesteader-selfsuffic: You can create farming tools from metal scraps.
Your hunger rate is reduced by {0}%%.
You can create farming tools from metal parts.
destariamasteries:homesteader-bitfruity-: Harvest {0}%% more from berry bushes, fruit trees, and pineapples.
Drinking fruit juice increases your walk speed by {0}%% for 30 seconds.
destariamasteries:homesteader-heartyvegg: You gain {0}%% more satiety from eating raw vegetables.
destariamasteries:homesteader-themiller-: You can operate the quern 4 times faster.
destariamasteries:homesteader-gentletouc: Attempt to calm an animal that has already been milked today with a {0}%% chance of success. On success, the animal becomes milkable again. The cooldown is only applied on failure.
destariamasteries:homesteader-grovetendi: Attempt to revive a dead cutting with a {0}%% chance of success. On failure, the cutting is destroyed. Furthermore, gain an additional {0}%% yield from berry bushes and fruit trees.
destariamasteries:homesteader-tothebone-: While holding a knife, you can exert yourself to strip every last bit from an animal or fish, adding 50%% to the yield. You can use this ability {0} times per day.
destariamasteries:homesteader-macrobrewe: You can give a fruit press a skillful spin, causing it to compress instantly. (Note: Due to server-client async, the animation may take a moment to catch up, but it will juice fully.) When filling a fruit press, there is a {0}%% chance to save the item.
destariamasteries:homesteader-itainteasy: You can craft a curdling agent from salt, vinegar, and certain fruit juices to instantly curdle milk.
destariamasteries:homesteader-rationing-: When planting seeds or using fertilizer, there is a {0}%% chance to save the item. Your satiety depletes {1}%% slower.
destariamasteries:homesteader-brewmaster: Once per day, you can use a temporal gear to accelerate the aging process of a sealed barrel. You also receive {0}%% less damage while drunk.
destariamasteries:homesteader-earlybird-: Every morning, the first crop you harvest restores 50%% of your health.
destariamasteries:homesteader-foolsflax-: Harvest {0}%% more flax fibers. Was it worth 30 points?
destariamasteries:homesteader-greenertha: Once per week, you can use 9 fertilizer to instantly mature all crops in a 3x3 area.
destariamasteries:homesteader-miracleofl: Once per day, you can assist a pregnant animal to give birth immediately.
